summary: Restore general policy and compound payment correctness, canonicalize FAQ obligations, port observability release documentation, and reduce main/composer prompt cost against 50e5975 without BigQuery changes.

Clean branch created from origin/product b99d4ab, the staging counterpart of live 50e5975; live revision gulong-chatbot-runtime-live-00106-vgr serves 100 percent traffic with RELEASE_VERSION and GIT_SHA 50e5975. BigQuery changes explicitly deferred.

Delivery failed because the main model omitted the FAQ tool before retrieval could run; compound payment failed because turn-wide deterministic hydration overwrote per-call scopes before deduplication.

Added typed delivery evidence recovery, exact-address pending obligations, clause-scoped payment hydration and cache separation, canonical FAQ obligation IDs, and selective main/composer prompt projection.
Five bounded runs covered 24 turns and 101 calls for 1454241 total tokens and estimated USD 0.48480738; final target delivery and original/reordered payment probes passed their scoped contracts.
Affected four-file suite passed 880 tests, all 28 Runtime V7 test modules passed 1552 tests, and the full repository suite passed 1631 tests. BigQuery and deployment remained untouched.
Latest BGC and original/reordered payment responses were grounded and understandable; delivery verbosity and regional phrasing remain broader response-quality review items.
Closed omitted request-coverage enforcement, incomplete-model-call multi-brand association, and conditional-delivery false-positive gaps; focused and repository suites remained green.

An exact live payment probe merged Home Credit with the 3-month clause and omitted that plan; generalized single-call clause scoping and missing-plan recovery were added, and the final rerun produced three distinct provider calls with the correct dispositions.

Affected four-file suite passed 888 tests, all 28 Runtime V7 test modules contain 1560 passing tests, and the full repository suite passed 1639 tests. Seven metered live-model runs totaled 115 calls, 1626655 tokens, and estimated USD 0.55626459. BigQuery and deployment remained untouched.
Final independent re-review found no P0 or P1 blockers after method-brand-option completion matching, cross-brand option isolation, and progress-aware mixed-authority retry handling were added.
